title: Proactive Defense Benchmark against Deepfake Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the proliferation of proactive defenses against deepfakes, the lack of a unified evaluation protocol precludes fair comparison and masks critical vulnerabilities. To bridge this gap, we present the first comprehensive benchmark that systematically assesses disruption, robustness, and transferability encompassing pixel, perceptual, and identity metrics. Our extensive analysis reveals that fidelity and identity metrics capture orthogonal performance axes, often leading to conflicting interpretations when relied upon individually. Furthermore, we identify a fundamental trade-off where peak white-box performance signals overfitting, and we introduce a calibrated evaluation to correct generator-induced identity bias. By exposing these blind spots, we establish a rigorous standard to guide the development of genuinely generalizable protections. Project page is available at: https://proactivedefensebenchmark.github.io/

translated_title: 针对深度伪造生成的主动防御基准
translated_abstract: 尽管针对深度伪造的主动防御方法不断涌现，但由于缺乏统一的评估协议，导致无法进行公平比较，也掩盖了关键性的漏洞。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了首个全面的基准，系统性地评估干扰效果、鲁棒性和可迁移性，涵盖像素、感知和身份三个层面的指标。我们广泛的分析表明，保真度指标与身份指标捕捉的是相互正交的性能维度，单独依赖其中任何一个往往会导致相互矛盾的解读。此外，我们发现了一个根本性的权衡现象：白盒设置下的峰值性能往往意味着过拟合，为此我们引入了一种校准评估方法以纠正由生成器引起的身份偏差。通过揭示这些盲点，我们建立了一套严格的标准，用以指导开发真正具备泛化能力的防护方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对深度伪造主动防御的综合评估基准，揭示了保真度与身份指标的矛盾解读以及白盒峰值性能背后的过拟合问题，并建立严格标准以推动真正可泛化防护方法的发展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive benchmark for proactive defenses against deepfakes, revealing conflicting interpretations between fidelity and identity metrics and the overfitting signaled by peak white-box performance, thereby establishing a rigorous standard to guide the development of genuinely generalizable protections.
